'''Telomere genotherapy''' was a medical branch of science that dealt with extending a being's life. When [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] was asked about his plans to extend his life indefinetely by [[11-4D/Legends|11-4D]], the droid replied that he had experience in these sciences.
